items.title: Gilead (GILD) Faces HIV Drug Access Criticism From AIDS Healthcare Foundation
items.summary: AIDS Healthcare Foundation publicly criticizes Gilead Sciences on its global HIV drug pricing and access policies. The advocacy group alleges that Gilead benefits from taxpayer-funded research while limiting affordable treatment options in low and middle income countries. The dispute focuses on licensing terms and pricing of key HIV therapies that are widely used in global treatment programs.
